name: mauwb-webassistant
description: Open web upper-computer for Jiuling/Makerfabs MaUWB_AOA anchors (Node + React)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mauwb/protocol && npm run build -w @mauwb/server && npm run build -w @mauwb/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mauwb/protocol && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @mauwb/server" "npm run dev -w @mauwb/web"
scripts.sample: npm run build -w @mauwb/protocol && npm run sample -w @mauwb/server --
